params.name: eventSummary
params.description: A filter to return only events whose summary matches the given value.

params.name: eventSummaryContains
params.description: A filter to return only events with a summary that contains the value provided.

params.name: id
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the event.

params.name: eventFingerprint
params.description: The eventFingerprint of the KernelEventData.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the compartment that contains the resources to list. This filter returns only resources contained within the specified compartment.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only events that match the state provided. The state value is case-insensitive.

params.name: resourceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the resource. This filter returns resources associated with the specified resource.

params.name: type
params.description: A filter to return only resources whose type matches the given value.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a paginated "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `50`

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `3`

params.name: timeCreatedLessThan
params.description:
A filter that returns events that occurred on or before the date provided.      
Example: `2016-08-25T21:10:29.600Z`

params.name: timeCreatedGreaterThanOrEqualTo
params.description:
A filter that returns events that occurred on or after the date provided.      
Example: `2016-08-25T21:10:29.600Z`

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated, timeOccurredAt and timeUpdated is descending. Default order for eventSummary is ascending.

params.name: isManagedByAutonomousLinux
params.description: Indicates whether to list only resources managed by the Autonomous Linux service.
